questions.question: What was the estimated annual death rate per 100,000 adults aged 30 and older attributable to PM2.5 in Kingsbridge - Riverdale during the 2005-2007 period?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_air_quality.csv')
filtered = df[(df['Name'] == 'Deaths due to PM2.5') & (df['Geo Place Name'] == 'Kingsbridge - Riverdale') & (df['Time Period'] == '2005-2007')]
result = float(filtered['Data Value'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Between Central Harlem - Morningside Heights and East Harlem, which neighborhood had a higher estimated annual PM2.5-attributable death rate among adults aged 30 and older for the 2005-2007 time period?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_air_quality.csv')
sub = df[(df['Name'] == 'Deaths due to PM2.5') & (df['Time Period'] == '2005-2007') & (df['Geo Place Name'].isin(['Central Harlem - Morningside Heights', 'East Harlem']))]
result = sub.sort_values(by='Data Value', ascending=False)['Geo Place Name'].iloc[0]

questions.question: How many entries in this air quality dataset report data aggregated at the borough level?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_air_quality.csv')
result = int((df['Geo Type Name'] == 'Borough').sum())

questions.question: Which three geographic area types account for the largest number of records in the dataset?

questions.question: Did the average summer ozone concentration in Coney Island (CD13) exceed 30 ppb in 2013?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_air_quality.csv')
val = df[(df['Name'] == 'Ozone (O3)') & (df['Measure'] == 'Summer mean') & (df['Geo Place Name'] == 'Coney Island (CD13)') & (df['Time Period'] == '2013')]['Data Value'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if val > 30 else 'no'
